bug.title: Done filter shows incomplete todos instead of completed ones
observed_steps: 00:05 - User checks the checkbox next to 'Buy milk' to mark it as done
00:09 - User switches to the 'Active' filter button
00:11 - User switches back to the 'Done' filter button
bug.expected: When the 'Done' filter is selected, only completed todos ('Buy milk') should be displayed in the list.
bug.actual: When the 'Done' filter is selected, the incomplete todos ('Walk dog' and 'Pay rent') are displayed, identical to the 'Active' filter view, while the completed todo ('Buy milk') is hidden.
evidence_timestamps: 00:05 — 'Buy milk' is checked and shown with a strikethrough under the 'All' filter, while 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' remain unchecked.
00:06 — 'Done' filter is selected (highlighted), but the list shows unchecked items 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent' instead of 'Buy milk'.
00:09 — 'Active' filter is selected and displays the exact same unchecked items ('Walk dog' and 'Pay rent').
00:11 — 'Done' filter is selected again and still displays 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent'.
bug.root_cause_hypothesis: In `app/public/app.js`, the `visibleTodos()` function (lines 28-32) has a copy-paste error in the condition for the `'done'` filter: `if (filter === 'done') return todos.filter(t => !t.done);`. Because it negates `t.done` instead of returning `t.done`, selecting the 'Done' filter returns active (incomplete) todos instead of completed ones.

verdict.original_video_summary: The user added three todos ('Buy milk', 'Walk dog', and 'Pay rent') between 00:01 and 00:04, marked 'Buy milk' as done at 00:05, and clicked the 'Done' filter at 00:06. Instead of showing the completed item ('Buy milk'), the UI displayed the two incomplete items ('Walk dog' and 'Pay rent'), matching the behavior of the 'Active' filter (seen at 00:09).
verdict.fixed_video_summary: The automated test added the same three todos ('Buy milk', 'Walk dog', and 'Pay rent') between 00:01 and 00:03, checked 'Buy milk' as done at 00:04, and selected the 'Done' filter at 00:05. The UI properly filtered the list to show only the completed 'Buy milk' item and hid the incomplete items.
verdict.comparison: In both videos, three todos ('Buy milk', 'Walk dog', 'Pay rent') are created and 'Buy milk' is marked as completed (original at 00:05, fixed at 00:04). When the 'Done' filter is selected in the original video (00:06–00:08 and 00:11–00:15), the list erroneously displays the unchecked items 'Walk dog' and 'Pay rent'. When the 'Done' filter is selected in the fixed video (00:05), the list displays only the checked item 'Buy milk' with a strikethrough.
verdict.pr_description:
## Summary
Fixes a bug where selecting the **Done** filter displayed incomplete (active) todos instead of completed ones.

## Root Cause
In `app/public/app.js`, `visibleTodos()` had a negated predicate for the `'done'` filter (`todos.filter(t => !t.done)`), which duplicated the `'active'` filter logic.

## Fix
Updated the `'done'` filter branch in `visibleTodos()` to return `todos.filter(t => t.done)`.

## Verification
Verified via automated UI test recording: added three tasks (`Buy milk`, `Walk dog`, `Pay rent`), marked `Buy milk` as completed, switched to the **Done** tab, and confirmed that only `Buy milk` is rendered.

rationale: In `app/public/app.js`, the `visibleTodos()` function mistakenly filters for `!t.done` when `filter === 'done'`. Updating this condition to filter by `t.done` ensures that selecting the 'Done' filter displays only completed todo items.
